div.head: II Cn 70
div.ab: And gif hwa cwydeleas of þysum life gewíte, si hit þurh his gymeleaste, si hit þurh færlicne deað, þonne ne teo se hlaford na mare on his æhta butan his rihtan heregeata.
And gif hwa cwydeleas of þissum life gewite, sy hyt þurh his gymeleaste, sy hit þurh fearlicne deað, þonne ne teo se hlaford na mare on his æhte butan his rihte heregeate.

Si quis quideles ex hac uita discesserit (decedat sine distributione rerum suarum), uel per incustodiam uel per mortem inprouisam, non usurpet sibi dominus eius de pecunia sua nisi quantum ad iustam releuationem pertinet (quę Anglice uocatur héregeat).
Be hergeate. Gyf of ðysum life man gewíte cwydeleas, sy hit ðurh his gymelyste, sy hyt ðurh færlicne deaþ, ðonne ne teo se laford nan mare on his æhte butan his rihtan heregeate.
Concerning heriots. If a man departs from this life intestate, whether through negligence or through sudden death, his lord shall take no more from his property than his legal heriot.

(Über ‘Hergewæte’. B) Und wenn einer (jemand B) ohne letztwillige Verfügung [für Kirche und Herrn] aus diesem Leben scheidet, sei es [sie unterblieb] durch seine Nachlässigkeit, sei es durch plötzlichen Tod, dann nehme aus dessen Fahrhabe der Herr nicht(s B) mehr als sein richtiges ‘Hergewæte’ [Kriegsrüstung].

(Concerning heriot. B) And if anyone (someone, B) departs this life without a last disposition [for church and lord], whether [it was left undone] through his negligence or through sudden death, then let the lord take from his movable goods no(thing, B) more than his proper heriot [war-gear].
